summary: New Pacific Metals Corp, a Canadian gold-silver explorer listed in the US via Form 6-K, furnished a Notice of Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular for a November 27, 2026 meeting, the US-equivalent of a routine annual proxy. Agenda items are receiving FY2026 audited financials, electing directors, re-appointing Deloitte LLP as auditor, and re-approving the Omnibus share-based compensation plan. Record date is October 23, 2026; the circular is incorporated by reference into the Form F-10 shelf. No transaction, ownership change, or capital event is disclosed; no deal terms apply.
